purpose: The ONLY place this repository may record that a vendored Cortex product gate or work package (v0.15 or v0.22) has moved off its shipped, honest default. scripts/cortex_package_gate.sh (v0.15) and scripts/cortex_package_gate_v022.sh (v0.22) both run scripts/cortex_honesty_invariant.py, which fails if a vendored gate_manifest.json claims a product_result other than NOT_RUN, or task_manifest.json a status other than 'Not started', without a matching row here that names a file in THIS repo which actually runs and is actually invoked. Every row is re-validated by both gates on every run.
how_to_add_a_row: 1. Implement the gate for real as a repo-owned script or test (e.g. scripts/cx02_observation_gate.sh). It must exit non-zero when the property it checks is false.

2. Wire it into an invoker that actually runs -- normally scripts/gate.sh. scripts/cortex_honesty_invariant.py greps the invoker for the executed_by path, so a row naming a script nothing calls is REJECTED. That is what stops this file becoming a rubber stamp.

3. Add a row below with gate_id, executed_by (repo-relative), invoked_by (repo-relative), allowed_product_result and a note saying what is measured. Every row is re-validated on every gate run, including rows for gates the package still reports as NOT_RUN -- a row whose script is deleted or unwired breaks the day it rots, not the day someone flips a manifest.

4. Do NOT edit the vendored gate_manifest.json. Two independent things forbid it: the package's own tools/validate_package.py hard-fails on any product_result other than NOT_RUN ('package must not claim a product run'), and SHA256SUMS_v0_15.json / SHA256SUMS_v0_22.json pin the file. NOT_RUN is a true statement about the PACKAGE -- 'this package does not execute it' -- and stays true no matter what this repository implements. This registry, not the vendored manifest, is where this repository records that it runs a gate.

5. If a future upstream release re-vendors the package WITH results filled in, the honesty check will accept a non-NOT_RUN product_result only for gates that have a valid row here, and only when the result is in allowed_product_result.
Removing a gate's implementation means removing its row.

gates.note: B283. Measured each run: pinned SHA256SUMS_v0_22.json (axon-package-sha256/1, both excluded files pinned) checked both directions by repo code before any package code; validator run with --output to target/ (never --refresh-hashes; self-grep refuses every argparse prefix), report deleted first, counts held to floors with orphan_gates exactly 0 (no zero-count false failure); whole-tree digest before/after package code (no self-hash cycle, no writes). Older pack retained: the v0.15 pack, scripts/cortex_package_gate.sh and gate.sh's call to it are asserted present. Stage 6, v022/stage6-pkggate.

B284. Manifests, owner exports, dependency/release closures, generated views, parent-lock bytes and Fabric reference bytes: tools/validate_package.py (+closed_loop_package_checks) run read-only after pinned integrity. Rationale + execution recipe for every new task/gate: the gate's own stdlib coherence stage (32 r22 work packages: non-empty requirement basis, numbered implementation sequence, verbatim acceptance text; 80/80 r22 gates covered). Documentation/reference conformance only.

B284. scripts/cortex_honesty_invariant.py: no v0.22 gate off NOT_RUN and no task off 'Not started' without a valid row here (every row re-validated); V022_RUNTIME_QUALIFICATION booleans false, no live evidence, no qualified profile; a skipped or expected-failure test inside the offline suite is a FAIL, never a pass (a suite that cannot start — pinned jsonschema absent — is printed as SKIPPED in the PASS line, logged to target/harness-skips.log, and fatal under AXON_HARNESS_STRICT=1); every PASS line is printed with the scope 'package conformance only — 0 product gates executed; NOT Rust implementation, physical backend evidence, real MiCode interoperability or measured self-improvement'.

B270. Settlement idempotent only for identical (origin, sequence, content); any other second settlement refused, recorded as settle_conflict, op disputed at the per-dimension max liability; replay refuses a duplicate settled line; Unknown billing keeps its full reservation; an Unknown-cost record never produces a zero-cost winner. Tests named in scripts/v022_stage5_gates.sh (axon-fabric/tests/journal.rs g13_*, axon-loop/tests/tel_price.rs). Dispute RESOLUTION is not implemented.

B270. Cohort cost divides by every ASSIGNED trial; unknown-cost records are unresolved, never free; the request's price_schedule_ref must equal the pinned schedule's cl22 Ref. Tests named in scripts/v022_stage5_gates.sh (axon-loop/tests/tel_price.rs). G10-r22-full-task-cost stays NOT_RUN: no operator execution price schedule (D10).

B261. WorkspaceVersion import refuses .., absolute, escaping symlinks, devices/FIFOs/sockets, non-UTF-8, control chars, duplicates, case/NFC collisions, file-and-dir, quota overflow (D11); digest byte-identical to MiCode's recipe via a cross-language fixture. axon-fabric/tests/workspace.rs.

B261/B264. A hash-only WorkspaceProjection cannot be materialized; hidden check suites are materialized read-only beside, never inside, the candidate and reach it only via AXON_PATH. axon-fabric/tests/{workspace,check_effects}.rs. Caveat: candidate code runs in the verifier process, so the effect ceiling, not the directory layout, keeps it from reading the suite.

B264. Substituted argv/executable, stale epoch → zero launch records; post-run change to candidate or suite makes the verdict unknown; executor refuses a receipt whose refs are not the version it sent. axon-fabric/tests/check_effects.rs.
B265. bind_acf refuses a context/request/receipt standing in as the verifier and a completed status not supervisor_observed; cross-tenant evidence is unknown with a reason. axon-loop/tests/evl.rs.
B265. A pass whose checked output is not exactly the receipt's output_workspace_ref is refused (checked in bind_acf itself). axon-loop/tests/evl.rs, axon-fabric/tests/check_effects.rs.
B271. Branches from one frozen published base, each with its own run id/writer, budgets carved inside one regime (Journal::reserve_within). axon-fabric/tests/branches.rs. No CLI verb yet.

B271. Publish requires expected head, current epoch, branch writer, a passing receipt from this journal/branch binding the exact version, and a declared approver who is not the writer; concurrent publishers: exactly one wins. Approvers/writers are declared names, not signatures. axon-fabric/tests/branches.rs.
B271. Cancelling a branch keeps every record and any liability and leaves sibling branches untouched. axon-fabric/tests/branches.rs.

tasks_note: A work package status other than 'Not started' needs a row in `tasks` with task_id and allowed_status. A status in {Done, Complete, Completed, Landed} additionally requires every one of that task's gate_targets to have a valid row in `gates` -- so 'Done' cannot launder an unexecuted gate.
